portfolio.headline: I will edit high-converting luxury product commercials and brand commercial ads

basic.title: Short Teaser Cut
basic.desc: Up to 30s punchy brand teaser with sound design, color grading, and 9:16 vertical social export.

standard.title: Commercial Highlight
standard.desc: 60s cinematic brand commercial with sound design, beat-synced pacing, and multi-format exports.

premium.title: Full Commercial Campaign
premium.desc: Complete ad campaign: 90s master commercial + 3 cutdowns (15s/30s/stories) + project archive.

faqs.question: What raw footage formats and resolutions do you support?
faqs.answer: We support all camera formats including Apple ProRes, RED RAW (R3D), Blackmagic RAW (BRAW), Sony XAVC/S-Log, Canon Cinema RAW Light, and Arri ProRes up to 8K.

faqs.question: How do you handle audio mastering and licensed commercial music?
faqs.answer: We use commercially licensed tracks from premium libraries (e.g. Artlist, Musicbed) with high-fidelity sound effects, dialogue cleanup, and broadcast-ready LUFS mastering.

faqs.question: Will you deliver vertical 9:16 cuts for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts?
faqs.answer: Yes! All tiers include or can be paired with bespoke 9:16 vertical exports with dynamic re-framing and mobile-optimized typography.

faqs.question: What is the revision turnaround time?
faqs.answer: Standard revision requests are typically completed and uploaded for your review within 24 to 48 hours.

portfolio.title: Amalfi Coast Romance
portfolio.overview: A tear-jerking luxury destination wedding film capturing emotional seaside vows, golden cliffside ceremonies, and elegant evening celebrations along the Amalfi Coast.
portfolio.headline: I will craft cinematic destination wedding films, emotional storytelling and 4K color grading

basic.title: Emotional Teaser
basic.desc: 60s cinematic wedding teaser with speech overlay, color grading, and social 9:16 cut.

standard.title: Cinematic Highlight Film
standard.desc: 3-5 min highlight film with multi-cam vows audio sync, licensed indie score, and drone footage.

premium.title: Full Feature Extended Documentary
premium.desc: 15-20 min full wedding documentary + 60s teaser + full ceremony/speeches multicam edit.

faqs.question: Can you synchronize multiple audio recorders, vows mics, and DJ feeds?
faqs.answer: Yes! We specialize in complex multi-mic synchronization. We align lapel mics from the groom and officiant with camera scratch audio and high-fidelity soundboard recordings.

faqs.question: How do you handle color grading for changing outdoor sunset lighting?
faqs.answer: We balance skin tones shot-by-shot in DaVinci Resolve, creating seamless exposure transitions from midday ceremonies into golden hour vows and candlelit evening receptions.

faqs.question: Can we choose or suggest our own wedding music soundtrack?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! You can provide a Spotify playlist of songs you love, and we will source licensed indie music with similar emotive pacing or clear rights through our Musicbed license.

faqs.question: Do you deliver a short vertical reel for Instagram / TikTok?
faqs.answer: Yes! All packages can include a vertical 9:16 teaser highlight formatted specifically for social media sharing.

portfolio.title: Neon Dreams Seoul
portfolio.overview: A high-octane indie pop music video edit featuring dynamic beat-sync cutting, anamorphic lens flares, halation glow, and trippy rhythm transitions across nighttime Seoul.
portfolio.headline: I will edit artistic music videos with rhythmic beat cutting, film grain and creative VFX

basic.title: Performance Cut
basic.desc: Up to 2 minutes performance-only cut with rhythmic pacing and film color grading.

standard.title: Full Official Music Video
standard.desc: Full track music video with story + performance cutting, VFX glows, and 4K export.

premium.title: Director's Cut Deluxe
premium.desc: Full music video + 3 social teasers + vertical reels + clean instrumental cut + master project archive.

faqs.question: How do you achieve perfect lip-sync across dozens of takes?
faqs.answer: We align every single performance take to the master stereo WAV timeline using waveform transient analysis, ensuring 100% frame-accurate lip sync.

faqs.question: Can you add creative vintage film grain, halation, and light leaks?
faqs.answer: Yes! We scan authentic 16mm/35mm Kodak film grain and apply organic halation, chromatic glow, and anamorphic lens flares tailored to your song's mood.

faqs.question: Do you offer vertical 9:16 cuts for Spotify Canvas and TikTok promo?
faqs.answer: Yes, our Standard and Deluxe tiers include vertical cutdowns and looping Spotify Canvas edits optimized for artist streaming pages.

portfolio.title: Guardians of the Serengeti
portfolio.overview: A poignant wildlife conservation documentary crafted with intimate telephoto pacing, spatial environmental foley, and naturalistic Rec.709 color fidelity.
portfolio.headline: I will produce cinema-grade documentary video editing, soundscapes and color grading

basic.title: Trailer & Pitch Cut
basic.desc: Up to 90 seconds festival trailer with dramatic score and color grade.

standard.title: Short Doc Featurette
standard.desc: 5 to 8 minutes narrative documentary short with voiceover cleanup and foley design.

premium.title: Full Festival Master Cut
premium.desc: Up to 20 minutes documentary cut with sound mastering, subtitles, and DCP export readiness.

faqs.question: How do you handle multi-language interview subtitling?
faqs.answer: We provide burned-in or sidecar .SRT subtitle tracks formatted for theatrical festivals, broadcast TV, or web streaming.

faqs.question: Can you restore shaky wildlife telephoto and handheld footage?
faqs.answer: Yes! We run optical flow gyro stabilization and planar tracking to smooth out severe micro-jitters without sacrificing edge sharpness.

faqs.question: Is sound design and environmental foley included?
faqs.answer: Yes, we build custom multi-layered soundscapes combining wild track audio, directional animal foley, and atmospheric wind/water textures.

portfolio.title: HyperDrive Cyberpunk EV
portfolio.overview: A futuristic electric supercar launch video featuring neon color grade, sound synthesis, whip-pan transitions, and thrilling chase sequences.
portfolio.headline: I will edit high-octane automotive commercials, car reels and futuristic promotional videos

basic.title: Social Reel / TikTok Cut
basic.desc: 30-60s fast-paced automotive reel with bass-boosted sound design and color grade.

standard.title: Commercial Launch Film
standard.desc: 90s full vehicle showcase with cinematic color grade, engine sound design, and drone shots.

premium.title: Full Dealership Package
premium.desc: Full commercial + 4 social cuts (vertical 9:16) + interior featurette + master source files.

faqs.question: Can you design custom engine sounds, drift FX, and electric car whines?
faqs.answer: Yes! We specialize in automotive sound synthesis, combining binaural exhaust notes, turbo spooling, tire squeals, and futuristic electric motor hums.

faqs.question: What speed ramp and motion blur techniques do you utilize?
faqs.answer: We use optical flow frame blending and curve-based speed ramping to transition smoothly between high-velocity driving and crisp slow-motion wheel details.

faqs.question: Can you remove license plates, reflections, or camera rigs from the car body?
faqs.answer: Yes, planar tracking and clean-plate patching in DaVinci Resolve Studio allow us to remove suction mounts, chase car reflections, and unwanted logos.

settings.tagline: From Raw Footage To A Compelling Final Video

footer.aboutText: Transform your footage into high-impact cinematic stories. Professional video editing, color grading, and visual storytelling that captivates audiences.

about.subtitle: Since 2022
about.bio1: For the past 4.5+ years, I have dedicated myself to the art of visual storytelling. Currently working as a Senior Cinematographer and Video Editor, I lead production workflows and collaborate with a talented team of creatives to deliver high-impact media for weddings and commercial clients.
about.bio2: My approach to editing is both technical and emotional. Whether I am crafting a fast-paced real estate promo, a heartfelt wedding trailer, or executing complex motion graphics and speed ramps, my goal is always to keep the audience engaged from the first frame to the last.

process.subtitle: FROM RAW FOOTAGE TO A COMPELLING FINAL VIDEO.
process.bottomBannerText: A structured, creative and detail-focused process that turns your raw footage into engaging, viral video content.

steps.title: Discovery & Planning
steps.desc: Understand your goals, audience and creative vision.

steps.title: Footage Organization
steps.desc: Ingest, back up and organize all raw footage for a smooth editing workflow.

steps.title: Rough Cut & Story Build
steps.desc: Arrange the best shots and craft the initial flow of the story.

steps.title: Editing & Polishing
steps.desc: Refine the cut, add transitions, graphics and maintain a strong narrative.

steps.title: Color, Sound & Refinement
steps.desc: Enhance the visuals with color grading, sound design and motion graphics.

steps.title: Final Review & Delivery
steps.desc: Review, make necessary revisions and deliver a ready-to-publish video.

brands.bottomText: Proven track record across commercials, cricket leagues, academic institutions & fashion brands.

items.text: Working with Parvej was an absolute game changer for our brand commercial. His pacing, color science, and sound design brought the video to life far beyond our expectations. Delivery was super fast and communication was top tier!

The cinematic wedding film Pollob edited for us made everyone in our family tear up! The emotional build-up, seamless transitions, and song choice were 10/10 perfection. I couldn't recommend his video editing skills enough.

Our Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts retention increased by over 300% after Parvej took over our editing workflows. His speed ramps and sound effects are unmatched in this industry. Truly an elite video editor!

Exceptional storytelling capabilities! He turned over 12 hours of raw nature and cultural footage into an engaging 15-minute documentary that won awards at our local film fest. Highly reliable and creative.

cta.subtitle: Let's collaborate and craft high-impact cinematic films and dynamic viral reels that captivate audiences and elevate your brand.

quote.text: "Every frame is a chance to move an audience. Filmmaking isn't just about putting clips together—it is about rhythm, emotional timing, and sculpting light so memories can live forever."
quote.statement: Framing emotions, sculpting light, and crafting stories that resonate forever.

profile.heading: HELLO, I AM POLLOB (TEST EDIT)
profile.bio: For the past 4.5+ years, I have worked across full production pipelines—from shooting on set with cinema gear to final master delivery. My goal is to deliver clean visual clarity, immersive color profiles, and punchy edits that stand out in any feed or theatre screen.

items.title: CINEMATIC WEDDING FILMS
items.subtitle: Emotional Storytelling
items.desc: Crafting non-linear, emotionally captivating wedding teasers and full-length feature films with bespoke pacing, speed ramps, and high-fidelity soundscapes.

items.title: COMMERCIALS & BRAND REELS
items.subtitle: High-Conversion Media
items.desc: Dynamic pacing, punchy typography, and trending motion design tailored to capture instant attention on Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TVC campaigns.

items.title: COLOR SCIENCE & LOOK DEV
items.subtitle: ACES & DaVinci Resolve
items.desc: Creating custom film-emulation LUTs, preserving organic skin tones, balancing multi-camera sensor variance, and delivering consistent cinematic mood.

items.title: POST-PRODUCTION & VFX
items.subtitle: Seamless Audio/Visual Sync
items.desc: Audio restoration, foley effects, rhythmic montage cuts, object masking, smooth warp transitions, and sophisticated visual enhancements.

achievements: Directed and finalized over 80+ high-end wedding films and 150+ commercial reels.
Established high-speed proxy workflows and automated post-production pipelines.
Achieved a 99% 5-star client satisfaction rating across domestic and global productions.
Edited narrative commercials for fashion, corporate, and culinary brands.
Managed color grading workflows for multi-cam shoots using DaVinci Resolve and Premiere Pro.
Collaborated closely with directors and audio engineers to hit strict broadcast deadlines.
Handled on-location camera rigs, lighting setups, gimbal tracking, and dual-system audio recording.
Organized and ingested raw footage, created rough cut assemblies, and delivered daily rushes.

cta.title: LET'S CRAFT YOUR NEXT CINEMATIC PROJECT
cta.subtitle: Ready to collaborate on weddings, high-converting commercials, or creative short-form videos? Let's turn your concept into reality.
